note: Verso body page. The top third is genuinely two-column - Fig. 1.1 and its caption occupy a left column (x 0.123-0.559, reaching out into the wide left margin) while paragraph n=1 runs beside it in a narrow right column (x 0.581-0.904) - so `left` and `right` are declared. From n=3 onward the text returns to the single full measure x 0.314-0.904, and those paragraphs are `full`; n=3 itself starts in the right column and wraps to full measure, so its bbox spans both. The page_header_band is the pale cyan #c6eafb strip across the top; it finishes in a solid cyan #00adef rule at y 0.0624-0.0666 (with a thin lighter #41c7f4 hairline above it over the outer half), reported as one band carrying the band's own #c6eafb fill. There is no footer_rule on this page. The grey #d1d2d4 panel holding the word 'Physics' (and a small two-square cyan/grey device) is the running header. The folio '2' sits in a pale cyan #c6eafb box in the outer bottom margin (page_number); the centred '2022-23' print-year line at the foot is recorded as running_header, the nearest available furniture role. A2 gives the figure as block n=2 with no text, and gives no block for its 'FIGURE 1.1 Rods and pith balls...' caption, so the caption element carries n: null rather than a guessed match. Figure captions in this chapter are printed in cyan #00adef.
